TL1_SRS_measurement_period (ms): Max(TReport, Ceil(1.5 X (M +L1)) X max(TSRS, TDRX))

Configuration: NOTE 1:TSRS is SRS measurement periodicity configured SRS-PeriodicityAndOffset, and TDRX is the DRX cycle length. TReport is configured periodicity for reporting.NOTE 2:M=1 if higher layer parameter timeRestrictionForChannelMeasurement is configured, and M=3 otherwise.
